entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A pyromancer task mage from Terisiare and later planeswalker, Chandra's teacher, killed by Ajani at the Battle of the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An ancient archmage of the School of the Unseen who taught Jaya and was saved by her from Mairsil's possession.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who drugged Jodah and assaulted Kjeldor; Jaya kept his severed hand.

entities.name: Mairsil the Pretender
entities.description: A spirit bound to a ruby ring that possessed Jaya for a decade.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker summoned by Jaya who casts the World Spell.

entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: Lim-Dûl's right hand, whom Jaya unsummons to Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: The dark keep where Jodah was drugged.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: The school at Lat-Nam where Jodah teaches.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: The head of the School of the Unseen who agreed to relocate the pit.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: A man Jaya helped who gave her an amulet to summon Freyalise.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: An elf whom Jaya guards in Yavimaya and helps give birth.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: Kaysa's partner, whose child Jaya helps deliver.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Jaya's student and apprentice, a pyromancer planeswalker.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane where Jaya posed as Mother Luti of Keral Keep.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: A monastery and fire-mage academy founded around Jaya's teachings.

entities.name: Serenok
entities.description: The abbot of Keral Keep.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who meets Gideon and Jaya on Dominaria and recommends splitting into teams.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels with Jaya on a skyship.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A band of planeswalkers Jaya helps without taking the oath.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: An enemy whom Jaya helps defeat.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whose invasion of Ravnica Jaya fights.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker whom the Gatewatch tries to assassinate and whom Jaya later tracks.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who warps time around Liliana and saves the team.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins Jaya in the attack on Liliana.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A character at whose behest Jaya and Chandra cremate the Eternals.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker Jaya escorts to Liliana's location.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: A traveler Jaya escorts.

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A traveler Jaya escorts.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who reveals the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who meets Jaya on Aerona and, compleated, kills her at the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A Benalian knight Jaya meets on Aerona.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A compleated foe Jaya fights.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: A compleated foe Jaya fights.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A character who rescues the fighters from a Phyrexian dreadnought.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: The battle in which Jaya was killed by compleated Ajani.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: Jaya's goggles
entities.description: Goggles Jaya wore throughout her career, kept as a relic and passed to Chandra.

events.summary: Jaya fails to steal from Jodah's chambers; sensing her magic he lets her study at the School of the Unseen, but she leaves to be a task mage.
events.quote: Sensing magical capabilities in her, Jodah allowed Jaya to study in the School of the Unseen at Lat-Nam

events.summary: Jaya finds Jodah missing and follows the trail to Tresserhorn.
events.quote: Eventually, the trail led to Tresserhorn .

events.summary: Jaya rescues Jodah, who was drugged by Lim-Dûl, and summons Freyalise, promising her the school's resources for her World Spell.
events.quote: She destroyed the pollen-bearing flower and rescued him

events.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle Jaya defeats Chaeska with an unsummon and claims Lim-Dûl's severed hand, unaware it bears Mairsil's ring.
events.quote: Jaya was successful in her battle and later claimed Lim-Dûl's severed hand as a battle trophy

events.summary: Jaya guides a group into Yavimaya, defends the elves, helps cleanse the Heart of Yavimaya and helps birth Kaysa and Jaeuhl's child.
events.quote: helped to birth Kaysa and Jaeuhl's child

events.summary: Jaya leads mages who fail to protect Kelsinko from the rising seas.
events.quote: Jaya was the leader of a group of mages who tried to protect the city of Kelsinko

events.summary: Jaya brings Jodah Lim-Dûl's hand with the ring finger missing, and they search for the ring.
events.quote: Jodah and Jaya set out to search for the missing ring

events.summary: Wearing the ruby ring, Jaya is possessed by Mairsil and cuts Jodah's throat, but Jodah survives and shatters his mirror in her face.
events.quote: She cut Jodah's throat, using his blood to revive the Phyrexian war beasts.

events.summary: Her planeswalker spark flares, Jaya erases Mairsil's presence and destroys the war beasts, then helps seal the pit and relocate the school.
Jaya gives Jodah an amulet to keep him sane and long-lived and leaves Dominaria.
events.quote: She then departed Dominaria for the wider multiverse .

events.summary: Jaya visits Regatha before the Mending, returns two hundred years later to find a religion based on her, and stays as Mother Luti; Chandra arrives later to study under her.
events.quote: chose to stay and nurture the community, posing as the elder Mother Luti

events.summary: Jace finds Gideon with Jaya on a skyship; after helping defeat Belzenlok, Jaya agrees to help the Gatewatch against Bolas without taking the oath.
events.quote: She didn't take the oath, jokingly stating that she was "not a joiner".

events.summary: Jaya goes to Ravnica with the Gatewatch and is trapped by the Immortal Sun while fighting Bolas's Eternals.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Jace, Jaya, Teferi and Vivien try to assassinate Liliana and nearly succeed until Bolas destroys the buildings and saves her; Teferi saves the others.
events.quote: Bolas stepped in and saved Liliana by destroying the buildings they were standing on

events.summary: At Samut's behest Jaya and Chandra cremate the inactive Eternals.
events.quote: she and Chandra cremated the bodies of the now-inactive Eternals

events.summary: Jaya secretly tracks Liliana to Dominaria and escorts Kaya, Teyo and Rat to her.
events.quote: Jaya secretly tracked Liliana to Dominaria

events.summary: At a peace summit at Oyster Bay, Karn and Teferi reveal the Phyrexian threat and Benalish sleeper agents are exposed; Jaya helps fight at Argivia.
events.quote: several of the Benalish knights were revealed as Phyrexian sleeper agents

events.summary: On Aerona Jaya fights compleated Ertai and Aron Capashen and is rescued by Radha, then is killed by compleated Ajani at the Mana Rig.
events.quote: She was killed by a compleated Ajani Goldmane at the Battle of the Mana Rig .

events.summary: After her death Jaya is memorialized on Shiv with four white pyramids and an ever-burning flame.
events.quote: Jaya was memorialized on Shiv with four white pyramids
